latestNews.details: Nichushkin (upper-body) will draw back into Colorado's lineup in St. Louis on Tuesday.

latestNews.fantasyDetails: The NHL's current iron man (925 consecutive games) has found a new home on Wednesday as Colorado signed Brent Burns to a one-year contract. latestNews.details: Kulak will make his Avalanche' debut on Wednesday vs. Utah.

The 32-year-old defenseman has accompanied his team to the Stanley Cup Finals in two straight seasons and will add some stability and experience to Colorado's blueline.
